turnout.notes: Louisiana turnout rows use official Secretary of State parish post-election statistics. The SOS page describes the denominator as qualified voters eligible for the election as of the close of registration records thirty days before election day; rows include active and inactive status voters and are election-level turnout, not presidential contest votes.

reviewCharts.warning: Louisiana review rows use official precinct/mode President rows compared with U.S. House rows where the same parish, ward, and precinct or vote-mode key is available. This is weaker than a statewide same-office comparison because House districts, uncontested or same-party races, incumbency, and candidate effects can dominate the signal. One-sided House rows are retained as vote-share context but do not produce drop-off direction.
